_README: ER-06 blocked-content vocabulary TEMPLATE (#2370). Copy to config/content_filter.local.json (gitignored) and fill with the real category names/keywords that must NEVER appear on any public surface. The repo is PUBLIC, so the real vocabulary is never committed: every consumer loads it through lambdas/privacy/content_filter_channel.py — env CONTENT_FILTER_JSON (the full object as a JSON string; inject as a CI secret to arm the CI gates), then config/content_filter.local.json, then the private S3 copy at config/content_filter.json (the runtime source of truth Lambdas consume). Matching is whole-word, case-insensitive; enforcement output never echoes the vocabulary back.

_meta.description: Public content safety filter — controls what data is hidden from all public-facing surfaces (website, emails, API responses).

rules.vice_streaks: Exclude any vice whose name case-insensitively matches blocked_vices from all public outputs.
rules.habit_data: Exclude matching habits from public habit displays, heatmaps, adherence reports.
rules.temptation_log: Never surface temptation entries with matching categories.
rules.ai_responses: System prompt must instruct Claude to never mention blocked terms.
rules.email_digests: All email Lambdas must filter blocked vices from BoD commentary.
rules.journal_entries: Passages mentioning blocked terms must not appear on public pages.
